name: bokea-android
description: Bokeà for Android. Runs the web app from Bokeà/wwwroot inside Capacitor.

scripts.sync: npm run sync:web && cap sync android
scripts.run: npm run sync && cap run android
scripts.build:debug: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.build:release: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
